description:
Save a product or service in the catalog, or update a saved one.

Without item_id it creates, or updates the item with the same
external_reference (else the same code): sending it twice never
makes two. Nothing fiscal is required to save; an NF-e still
needs ncm and cfop when issued. It issues nothing. Confirm the
data with the user when any of it was inferred.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

description.description: What is sold: at most 120 characters for a product (NF-e), 2000 for a service. Required to create.

external_reference.description: Another system's id, unique in the company.

gross_weight.description: Product: kg per unit, NF-e only.

internal_code.description: Service: own code, up to 20 letters or digits.

iss_retained.description: Service: ISS retained by the customer.

item_id.description: Update this saved item instead of creating one. Only the fields sent change.

kind.description: product (NF-e) or service (NFS-e). Required to create; a field of the other kind is refused.

nbs.description: Service: nine-digit NBS. Only from the user or a suggest_nbs row they confirmed.

ncm.description: Product: 8 digits. Only from the user or classify_item once confirmed; never inferred.

net_weight.description: Product: kg per unit, NF-e only.

source.description: Set on creation only; manual by default.

tax_situation.description: Product: ICMS CST (2 digits) or CSOSN (3).

name: save_item

outputSchema.description: One product or service the company sells, kept in its catalog.

id.description: Pass it as item_id to issue_invoice or save_item.
